notes.title: HTC Vive support update is live!
notes.content:
If you use a Vive or Vive Pro series headset, Valley General Hospital NiVR now supports your hardware! You will be able to enable support for your Vive headset once you have entered our lobby— a new menu will allow you to select from two ranges of hardware, HTC Vive and Oculus brand PC-VR headsets.

There are plenty more headsets out there for us to support, and we're working hard to enable our brand of Healthcare training for all of your headsets. So, what Headset would you like to see us support next?
